description: This script manages external web dependencies for the coocook project, including downloading and installing packages, with a WebDependency class handling package details and extraction.

classes.name: WebDependency
classes.description: Represents a web dependency package, handling download, extraction, and path management.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads the dependency archive to a specified directory.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts the dependency archive into the appropriate directory, supporting various formats.

methods.name: print_command
methods.description: Prints a formatted command message for download or install actions.

methods.name: print_status
methods.description: Prints the status of a download or installation process.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new WebDependency object with package details.

methods.name: archive_name
methods.description: Returns the filename of the archive to be downloaded.
